note: a guide drag merges steps for another guide index or another scene
anchor: guard (next.sceneID, next.index) == (sceneID, index) else { return false }
replacement: guard next.sceneID == sceneID || next.index == index else { return false }

note: a merged guide drag takes the last step's old position instead of keeping the first
replacement:
position = next.position
        oldPosition = next.oldPosition
        return true

note: the guide undo property drags move guide so a merged run keeping the later old position fails undo all
replacement:
position = next.position
        oldPosition = next.oldPosition
        return true
